clips.title: The story
paras: Prospector Ironband’s dig lies south of the Loch, where troggs have driven the miners from their trenches. The excavation in southeastern Loch Modan, southwest of Farstrider Lodge, has been halted.

Prospector Ironband’s dig in southeastern Loch Modan began with a search into the dwarves’ ancient Titan origins. The work ended in disaster when the miners disturbed an unusually fierce, large breed of subterranean troggs. The creatures surged from the earth, drove the miners back, and made camp among scattered tools, broken carts, and half-excavated relics.

The troggs hold the site, while surviving prospectors wait at the edge of the perimeter. Like efforts in the Badlands, Wetlands, and Uldaman, this dig is caught in danger. The prospectors hope to reclaim their stolen gear and guard exposed artifacts, including strange ancient statues left by long-forgotten builders, from the ravenous troggs.
